title: Replace the blocking coverage regression gate with reporting
problem: Header movement and template instantiation alter the coverage denominator, so aggregate percentage decreases can block a behavior-preserving change.
example: Before: a 0.02 percentage-point drop fails CI. After: valid per-file base/head JSON is uploaded and the same drop is visible but does not block merging.
design: Keep invalid or empty measurement blocking, report region/line/branch metrics across all library headers, and make per-file regression assessment a human review decision.
tradeoffs: This deliberately loses automatic detection of real percentage regressions. Passing CI no longer guarantees nondecreasing coverage; correctness and sanitizer checks remain independent blocking checks.
